mapper.select: SELECT MCPLI.ST_LINK_ID , MCPLI.CAND_ROUTE_ID, CGSL.ROAD_NAME , CGSL.ROAD_RANK , MCPAI.LENGTH , MCPAI.LENGTH_RATIO , MCPAI.SCORE , ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_LINEMERGE(CGSL.GEOMETRY)) AS GEOJSON FROM MRT_CNDCY_PATH_LINK_INFO MCPLI INNER JOIN MRT_CNDCY_PATH_ADD_INFO MCPAI ON MCPLI.CAND_ROUTE_ID = MCPAI.CAND_ROUTE_ID INNER JOIN C_GM_STD_LINK_TMP CGSL ON MCPLI.ST_LINK_ID = CGSL.LINK_ID WHERE MCPLI.CAND_ROUTE_ID = #{candRouteId} ORDER BY MCPLI.LINK_SEQ ASC

select mcpai.length , mcpai.length_ratio , mcpai.score , ST_UNION(ST_LINEMERGE(cgsl.geometry)) as geojson from mrt_cndcy_path_link_info mcpli inner join mrt_cndcy_path_add_info mcpai on mcpli.cand_route_id = mcpai.cand_route_id inner join c_gm_std_link_tmp cgsl on mcpli.st_link_id = cgsl.link_id where mcpli.cand_route_id = #{candRouteId} group by mcpai.length ,mcpai.length_ratio ,mcpai.score
